question: Why is immense material wealth insufficient compared to this Kaula teaching?
premises: One might possess wealth enough to fill the ocean with jewels.
It is contrasted with the value of the teaching.
inference: Even wealth vast enough to fill the ocean with jewels does not equal this teaching.
uncertainties: ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is textually irregular and its exact parsing is uncertain.
plain_english: Even if one had an accumulation enough to fill the ocean with jewels...
